question: Operator step with a Stadia Maps account on the Free plan (after the 14-day Professional trial ends): send one keyed request each to GET /geocoding/v1/search, GET /geocoding/v2/search, GET /geocoding/v2/autocomplete and POST /route/v1 and record each HTTP status (403 or 200).
why: The docs plan grid of the v1 search page marks Forward Geocoding unavailable on Free, while the v2 announcement (updated 2026-07-02) and the changelog entry of 2025-04-08 say forward geocoding is on all plans; only a keyed request shows which holds.
